label: preparing
what: Likely a privately funded celebration or communal gathering in the great hall, possibly for my forty years of service, concealed behind the precisely timed lighting inspection tomorrow at 18:00. Innkeeper arranges 200 fresh loaves for the four table chests by 17:00; freight contributes money and assists layout, and builder arranges lanterns and my attendance. Secretary knowingly helps schedule the inspection, but evidence does not establish that secretary knows of any concealed celebration. The gathering preparations are strongly supported; the anniversary purpose remains an inference.
